description.value: Paradiso Caffè e Gelato is a beloved Kitsilano dessert shop that has been crafting small-batch artisanal gelato and sorbetto using fresh BC milk and cream since 2002. Cyclists rolling through the Yew Street corridor can refuel with gelato in a cone, on egg waffles, or paired with locally roasted Vancouver coffee or ceremonial-grade matcha. The shop also offers catering and gift cards, suggesting a well-established local presence.
